title: pvParallelNetCDFPOPreader
body:
## pvParallelNetCDFPOPreader

Reads Parallel Ocean Program (POP) output stored in NetCDF (.pop.ncdf, .pop.nc) into a rectilinear grid, with only some MPI processes reading the file and sending the data to the others. ParaView marks this proxy mpi_required, so it is meant for runs with several ranks; for serial runs use pvNetCDFPOPreader. VariableArrayStatus selects the ocean variables and Stride subsamples the grid.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- In an ordinary single-rank Schemaxis run this reader may be unavailable; set ranks above 1 (mpiexec pvbatch) or use pvNetCDFPOPreader.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `ParallelNetCDFPOPreader`. Identity: `sources/PNetCDFPOPReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Stride` | This property indicates the number of indices per dimension (i,j,k) to skip between each point included in this output. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `VariableArrayStatus` | NetCDF variables to load onto the grid, e.g. potential temperature or salinity (POP names such as TEMP or SALT). Variables not listed are not read, which saves memory and transfer between processes. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvParallelNetCDFPOPreader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
